title: 第15章 分别，贵重礼物

content_zh:
“这，这也太霸道了吧。”阳顶天道。
“是啊，是很霸道啊！”西门无涯道，嘴角带着淡淡的冷漠和嘲讽。
还不止这么霸道，阳顶天发现海面上所有的船只不止让开了航道，而且所有的穿都停了下来，静止不前，恭恭敬敬地在两边列队排好，仿佛等着即将到来的玄天宗大船的检阅。甚至前面即将靠岸的船只，也立刻离开了码头，到两边海域上排好，整个硕大忙碌的码头，清理一空等待玄天宗船只的靠岸。
甚至，整个忙碌嘈杂的海面，也瞬间寂静无比。
足足一个多小时后，阳顶天的眼睛都要望酸了，玄天宗的大船才姗姗来迟。
足足十艘大船，每一只都通体雪白，华丽威风，在整个海面上所有的船只中显得鹤立鸡群。
雪白大船经过之处，每一艘船都整齐列队，挥舞旗帜敬礼。但是玄天宗的雪白大船上没有任何回礼，每一艘大船上带着一名白衣弟子，冷漠地盯着两边的船只。
云霄城的大船也派人挥舞旗帜敬礼了，却没有让所有人都在甲板上列队，顿时玄天宗船头上的白衣弟子冷冷地瞪来一眼。
西门无涯不屑移开目光，索性连挥舞的旗帜也让停了。这个云霄城主虽然温文尔雅，但内在确实桀骜不驯的。
一名玄天宗的弟子见到云霄城如此回应，面色一冷，顿时走下船舱禀报去了，西门无涯只是不屑笑笑。
“义父，我们这样做，只怕在大宴上玄天宗会更加羞辱我们。”西门炎此时走到身边低声说道。
“无妨，言语上被挤兑两句没什么。”西门无涯冷冷道：“玄天宗是霸道，但是除了言语上，他们又能耐我西门无涯几何？”
这话声音虽平淡但却霸气凛然，顿时西门炎目中顿时充满了崇敬，就连阳顶天也不由得暗暗心折。西门无涯对弱者亲切尊重，对强者不畏惧折腰，是真正的高手风范。
足足一个多小时后，玄天宗的船队才走远靠岸，海面上的其他船只才纷纷启航。
******
“孩子，我们马上就要分别了。”在阳顶天所住的舱房内，西门无涯道：“你这一入阴阳宗，我们便相隔万里。不过你资质绝顶，相信用不了多久，我就可以在云霄城听到你的传说了。”
“不过在这里我还要问你最后一句。”西门无涯道：“我想把焰焰许配给你，想让你成为云霄城的下一任主人，你愿意吗？”
“砰……”门外，好像有人东西掉到了地上。
西门无涯没有理会，而是继续说道：“我会尽一切去培养你，还是那句话，阴阳宗能给你的东西，我未必不能给。”
“爹爹，我不要……”外面，传来西门焰焰惊恐愤怒的声音，然后一阵香风，一团火红色的倩影冲了进来。

“出去……”西门无涯猛地一声断喝。
顿时，一股强大的能量直接将西门焰焰的娇躯推出去好几米，然后舱门直接关闭。
西门无涯目光充满期待地望着阳顶天，等待他最后的回答。
阳顶天心乱如麻，倒不是他不知道怎么选择，他早就已经有了决定。但是面对西门无涯充满期切的目光，拒绝的言语他真的有些说不出来。
对于西门无涯，他真的很心折。西门焰焰，真的很动人，甚至性格和阳顶天在地球上的女友很相似，都是如同火一般的野性女孩，不过李碧寒更加成熟大胆，西门焰焰野性中却带着单纯。
“对不起了，西门城主，我无法答应。”阳顶天深深弯腰鞠躬到底。
“哼……”顿时，外面传来了西门焰焰不屑带着愤怒的冷哼。
“唉……”西门无涯轻轻叹息一声，道：“我就知道是这个答案，但还是不甘心。”
接着，西门无涯伸手摸了摸阳顶天的头顶道：“好孩子，我相信你在阴阳宗也能够光芒万丈的。日后与我相对的时候，可要手下留情哦……”
阳顶天顿时大窘道：“您，那么厉害，我怎么可能是您的对手？再说，我对您那么尊敬，怎么可能会对您动手？”
“哈哈……将来的事情，谁说得清楚。”西门无涯道。
“孩子，你的隐私我不好窥探，但是我想你万里迢迢到阴阳宗，除了要入阴阳宗大概还有别的重要事情。但是这很长一段时间阴阳宗大概都会很忙，你想必也见不到阴阳宗的重要人物，甚至连阴阳宗的门都进不去。”西门无涯道：“那你对下一步，有什么计划吗？”

content_en:
"This, this is too overbearing." Yang Dingtian said.
"Yes, he is very domineering!" Ximen Wuya said, with a touch of indifference and ridicule on his lips.
Not only was he so overbearing, Yang Dingtian found that all the ships on the sea not only gave way to the waterway, but also all the ships stopped and stood still, respectfully lining up on both sides, as if waiting for the upcoming inspection of the Xuantian Sect's ship. Even the ships that were about to dock in front immediately left the dock and lined up on both sides of the sea. The entire huge and busy dock was cleared and waited for the Xuantian Sect ships to dock.
Even the entire busy and noisy sea became extremely silent for an instant.
After more than an hour, Yang Dingtian's eyes were almost sore, and the Xuantian Sect's big ship arrived belatedly.
There are ten large ships, each one is white in color, gorgeous and majestic, and stands out among all the ships on the sea.
Wherever the snow-white ship passed, every ship lined up neatly, waved flags and saluted. However, Xuantian Sect's snow-white ships did not return any gifts. Each ship carried a disciple in white, staring indifferently at the ships on both sides.
The big ship in Yunxiao City also sent people to wave flags and salute, but they did not let everyone line up on the deck. Suddenly, the disciples in white on the bow of Xuantian Sect gave them a cold look.
Ximen Wuya didn't bother to look away, and simply stopped waving the flag. Although the Lord of Yunxiao City is gentle and gentle, he is really rebellious on the inside.
When a disciple of the Xuantian Sect saw Yunxiao City's response, his face turned cold and he immediately stepped down from the cabin to report. Ximen Wuya just smiled disdainfully.
"Father, if we do this, we are afraid that the Xuantian Sect will humiliate us even more at the banquet." Ximen Yan walked up to him and whispered.
"It doesn't matter, it's okay to be bullied for a few words." Ximen Wuya said coldly: "The Xuantian Sect is domineering, but apart from words, how much can they do to me, Ximen Wuya?"
Although these words were spoken in a plain but domineering voice, Ximen Yan's eyes were immediately filled with reverence, and even Yang Dingtian couldn't help but feel secretly sad. Ximen Wuya treats the weak with kindness and respect, and is not afraid to bow down to the strong. He is a true master.
After more than an hour, the Xuantian Sect's fleet arrived at the shore, and other ships on the sea set sail one after another.
****
"My child, we will be separated soon." In the cabin where Yang Dingtian lives, Ximen Wuya said: "As soon as you join the Yin Yang Sect, we will be thousands of miles apart. But you are extremely qualified. I believe it won't be long before I can hear your legend in Yunxiao City."
"But I have one last question for you here." Ximen Wuya said: "I want to betroth Yanyan to you and make you the next master of Yunxiao City. Are you willing?"
"Bang..." Outside the door, someone seemed to have dropped something to the ground.
Ximen Wuya ignored it and continued: "I will do everything to cultivate you. Again, I may not be able to give you what the Yin Yang Sect can give you."
"Daddy, I don't want..." Ximen Yanyan's frightened and angry voice came from outside, and then a gust of fragrant wind and a fiery red figure rushed in.
"Get out..." Ximen Wuya shouted suddenly.
Suddenly, a powerful energy directly pushed Ximen Yanyan's delicate body several meters away, and then the hatch was closed directly.
Ximen Wuya looked at Yang Dingtian expectantly, waiting for his final answer.
Yang Dingtian was in a state of confusion. It wasn't that he didn't know how to choose. He had already made his decision. But facing Ximen Wuya's expectant eyes, he really couldn't say the words of rejection.
He was really heartbroken about Ximen Wuya. Ximen Yanyan is really touching, and her personality is even very similar to Yang Dingtian’s girlfriend on earth. They are both wild girls like fire. However, Li Bihan is more mature and bold, while Ximen Yanyan’s wildness has innocence..
"I'm sorry, Lord Ximen, I can't agree." Yang Dingtian bowed deeply and bowed to the end.
"Hmph..." Suddenly, Ximen Yanyan's disdainful and angry snort came from outside.
"Alas..." Ximen Wuya sighed softly and said, "I knew this was the answer, but I still wasn't willing to accept it."
Then, Ximen Wuya reached out and touched Yang Dingtian's head and said: "Good boy, I believe you can shine brilliantly in the Yin Yang Sect. When you face me in the future, please be merciful..."
Yang Dingtian was suddenly embarrassed and said: "You are so powerful, how can I be your opponent? Besides, I respect you so much, how can I attack you?"
"Haha... Who can say clearly what will happen in the future." Ximen Wuya said.
"Child, I don't want to pry into your privacy, but I think you have traveled all the way to the Yin-Yang Sect. In addition to joining the Yin-Yang Sect, you probably have other important things to do. But the Yin-Yang Sect will probably be very busy for a long time, and you will not be able to see the important figures of the Yin-Yang Sect, and you will not even be able to enter the Yin-Yang Sect." Ximen Wuya said: "Then do you have any plans for the next step?"
